setup.title: ### {icon} Quick setup
setup.welcome_meta: -# 7 short steps · about 2 minutes · nothing is required
setup.intro: I'll ask about the parts most servers use. Answer only what you care about — every step can be skipped, and each answer is saved before the next step appears.
setup.no_permission: {cross} You need the **Manage Server** permission to run setup.
setup.timeout: This setup panel has closed. Run `/setup` again to carry on — every step you finished was already saved.
setup.error:
**That step could not be saved.** {error}

Nothing was changed — try again, or press **Skip this step** to move on.
setup.footer: -# Nothing is saved until you press **Save & continue**. **Skip this step** leaves that feature exactly as it is, and running `/setup` again never undoes work you already saved.
setup.welcome_body:
**What you can set up here**
- **Leveling** — a level and XP score for active members *(off by default)*
- **Automatic moderation** — removes spam, invite links and mass pings
- **Blocked words** — words you never want posted, plus ready-made filter lists
- **Welcome messages** — a greeting posted whenever someone joins
- **Server logs** — one channel that records what happens in your server
- **Support tickets** — a button members press to start a private chat with staff
- **AI chat** — members can talk to Niko in your server

-# Nothing changes until you choose it, and you can stop at any time.
setup.leveling_body: Members earn XP (experience points) for chatting, level up over time, and can receive a role when they reach a level.
setup.leveling_state: **Leveling is currently {state}.** New servers start with it **off**, so you only see levels if you want them.
setup.leveling_hint: You can change the XP rate, level roles, the level-up message and the card style later with `/leveling panel` or from the dashboard.
setup.leveling_saved_on: {tick} Leveling is on — members will start earning XP.
setup.automod_body: Turn on the checks you want Niko to run on every new message. Tap a check once to switch it on, and again to switch it off.
setup.automod_hint: **Raid protection** watches how fast people join and can kick or lock the server during an attack. Every check can be fine-tuned later with `/automod`.
setup.words_body:
Add words you never want to see in your server. Niko can delete or censor them automatically.

You can type your own words, pick a ready-made list below, or do both.
setup.words_empty: No words of your own added yet.
setup.words_modal_label: Words to block (separate with commas or new lines)
setup.presets_hint: Ready-made lists catch sneaky spellings — like `w0rd` or letters split with spaces — that a plain word list misses. Niko keeps them up to date; you can pick more than one.
setup.words_saved: {tick} Blocked words saved: {words} of your own and {presets} ready-made list(s).
setup.onboarding_body:
Greet every new member with a message in a channel you choose.

Pick the channel below — Niko posts there whenever someone joins.
setup.onboarding_hint: You can edit the welcome text, add automatic roles, rules and verification later with `/onboarding setup` — this step only picks the channel.
setup.onboarding_saved: {tick} Welcome messages will be posted in {channel}.
setup.logging_body:
Keep a record of what happens in your server — deleted messages, moderation actions, joins and leaves — in one channel.

Pick where those records should go.
setup.logging_hint: Later you can send each type of event to a different channel with `/logging`, or from the dashboard.
setup.tickets_body:
Let members open a private conversation with your staff instead of messaging them directly. Niko posts a panel with a button members can press.

Choose the channel for that panel.
setup.tickets_placeholder: Choose a channel for the ticket panel
setup.tickets_selected: **The ticket panel will be posted in** {channel}.
setup.tickets_hint: Staff roles, ticket categories and the panel wording can be changed later with `/ticket setup`.
setup.ai_body: Members can chat with Niko by mentioning it or saying its name. It answers using this server's own settings and needs no extra permissions.
setup.ai_hint: You can change its name and personality, or switch experiments on, later with `/ai-config`.
setup.ai_saved_on: {tick} AI chat is on — members can talk to Niko.
setup.ai_saved_off: {tick} AI chat is off in this server.
setup.done_empty: Nothing was changed — that's fine. Run `/setup` again whenever you want to turn something on.
setup.done_next:
**What next**
- Run `/setup` again whenever you want to change something
- Run `/help` to see every command
- Ask in the support server if anything is unclear

-# You can close this message — nothing here is left half-finished.

commands.setup.description: Guided setup for this server's features
commands.setup.help: Walk through leveling, AutoMod, blocked words, welcome messages, logs, tickets and AI.
